draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Kasaragod! It's known as the Land of Seven Languages, and the town sits right where the Chandragiri River runs into the Arabian Sea.
draft.hungryLine: Kasaragod is famous for sweets like holige, and steamed favourites such as puttu, idiyappam and kalthappam are everywhere.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Nellikunnu Muhyaddin Juma Masjid is a 14 min walk, and the Malik Dinar Mosque, one of the oldest in India, is a short drive away in Thalangara.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Do the riverside walk at Pulikunnu where the road wraps around the Chandragiri River, or catch the sunset at Thalangara Wharf.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kasaragod district has 12 rivers, the most of any district in Kerala.

spots.name: Nellikunnu Muhyaddin Juma Masjid
spots.detail: 14 min walk · Sunni Friday mosque and dargah

spots.name: Malik Dinar Mosque
spots.detail: Short drive · Believed completed around 642/643 CE

spots.name: Nellikkunnu Beach
spots.detail: 2 km from the KSRTC stand · Lighthouse and a 5 km beach road

legends.title: The Uroos festival
legends.body: The Nellikunnu Uppappa Mosque, with its madrasa, dargah and big steps, is famous for its Uroos festival. Nellikunnu is also where the tomb of Thangal Uppapa is.

tips.title: Catch sunset at Thalangara Wharf.
tips.body: Wikivoyage calls it the most beautiful spot in all of Kasaragod, about 5 km from town.

tips.title: Walk to Madhur Temple.
tips.body: A 7 km route starts at Karandakkatt junction near the new bus station and ends at the temple on the riverside.

story.title: An ancient mosque
story.body: Malik Dinar is said to have founded the mosque at Thalangara, believed completed around 642/643 CE. That makes it one of the oldest mosques in India.

story.title: Forts on the coast
story.body: Chandragiri Fort dates from the 17th century, one of several forts around here along with Arikady, Bekal and Hosdurg.

story.title: A municipal town
story.body: Kasaragod became a municipal town in 1966, the first in what is now the district.

story.title: A district of its own
story.body: Kasaragod was part of Kannur district until 24 May 1984, and it's still the last district Kerala has formed.

story.title: A new look
story.body: The Malik Dinar Mosque, built in the Kerala-Islamic style, was extensively remodelled in the Islamic style in 2018.
